**Finding: compliant** (rule NOSOLICIT — non-solicitation of employees binding Customer).

The agreement imposes **no** non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant on Mortgage Logic.com:

- Searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce", "personnel", "recruit" surfaced only § 7 (unsolicited commercial e-mail / spam) and incidental references to "employees" in § 8(c) access restrictions and § 12 indemnity — none restrict hiring or soliciting either party's staff.
- Both planner-flagged sections were read in full: § 8 (Client covenants) ends with compliance, notification, access limitation, credit-data licence, Client representations and spamming; § 10 (Confidentiality) contains only standard confidentiality/exclusion mechanics.
- The sole restrictive-covenant cross-reference (§ 8(d), the "Non-Competition Agreement") constrains use of **Credit Data**, not personnel, and sits in a separate instrument.

This is our **preferred** position — no non-solicit on the Customer — so no redline was proposed. Worth noting for the file only: if the separately executed Non-Competition Agreement contains personnel restrictions, it should be reviewed under this rule in its own right.
